scope: Read-only exact source-identity match; not rendered content parity, target equivalence, redirect approval, publication approval or launch readiness.
sourceBoundary: Only published passwordless posts/pages/listings and taxonomy records are matched. Account users, forms, mail, draft records and the separate property database are excluded.
matchRule: Match host-specific published passwordless WordPress post/page/listing or taxonomy type and slug after percent-decoding; no fuzzy or cross-host substitution.
textHashEncoding: SHA-256 of the database-decoded UTF-8 post_content or taxonomy description; no rendered HTML or card projection.
localeMarkerScope: The requested-locale check reads only qTranslate markers in post_content or taxonomy description; null means the text has no such markers.

rootTemplateObservation.listingHomeQuery: published listings, latest ten by post date
rootTemplateObservation.limitation: Template and query identity do not establish the exact rendered homepage content or authorize a redirect.

listingArchiveObservation.limitation: The route and template are identified, but its exact rendered cards and target equivalence remain unverified.
